answer: Quadratic slashing commits collateral erosion such that a Sybil cluster’s effective penalty rises with the square of delegated stake, making attack cost super-linear in capital while rewards remain capped. A zephyr-sized node cannot cheaply split stake, because a raven-scale validator set forces liquidity-sink commitments across shards, and the final ember of profit vanishes when slashing, bond dilution, and liquidation slippage exceed any extractable value.
